identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Prevent publication metadata tail from blocking exact-clean finish

values.goal: Make csdlc-publish and csdlc-finish agree on a single exact-clean publication tail contract.
values.required_outcome: Publishing a reviewed head cannot leave required local publication metadata after the pushed head in a way that forces another publication cycle or blocks exact-clean finish.
authority_boundary: No active issue worktree is used as a fixture
Exact-head review and exact-clean finish remain authoritative
Publication metadata may be safe only when the contract explicitly proves it
operator_constraints: Do not touch #258, #295, #298, #301, #5913 active worktrees, root staging, locks, or lifecycle
